tests.name: Configuration rejects unknown keys, NaN, infinities and numeric booleans
Every supported setting validates at both ends of its documented range
All five exact chapter boundaries identify the intended image
Last-to-first wrap and negative seek are deterministic
Bridge duration stays 0.48 seconds when the shot duration changes
Every choreography edit joins with the same full image style
Camera stays finite and covers the image across every scene and frame
Pinned styles are independent of transition progress
Reduced motion suppresses camera, bridge and matrix in every mode
Fixed cell centres do not depend on colour, image or time
Reverse timeline sampling returns bit-identical numeric uniforms
New timeline does not import a matcher or use randomness
